events.text: US BLS Employment Situation released Jan 10 2025: December 2024 nonfarm payroll employment rose by 256,000; unemployment rate was 4.1%.
US BLS CPI released Jan 15 2025: December 2024 seasonally adjusted CPI rose 0.4% month over month, while unadjusted annual CPI rose 2.9%.

Bank of Japan Jan 24 2025 monetary policy statement: raised its uncollateralized overnight call rate target to around 0.5%, effective Jan 27. BOJ stated that real interest rates were expected to remain significantly negative and further tightening would depend on the outlook.
events.observed_result: Rate target increased to around 0.5%, effective Jan 27

events.text: US Federal Reserve FOMC Jan 29 2025 statement: maintained the federal funds target range at 4.25% to 4.50%. The statement described continued solid economic expansion and somewhat elevated inflation.
US BLS Employment Situation released Feb 7 2025: January 2025 nonfarm payrolls increased 143,000; unemployment rate declined to 4.0%.
US BLS CPI released Feb 12 2025: January 2025 seasonally adjusted CPI rose 0.5% month over month; unadjusted 12-month increase was 3.0%.
US BLS Employment Situation released Mar 7 2025: February 2025 nonfarm payroll employment increased by 151,000; unemployment rate was 4.1%.
US BLS CPI released Mar 12 2025: February 2025 seasonally adjusted headline CPI rose 0.2% m/m and 2.8% y/y unadjusted.

Bank of Japan Mar 19 2025 monetary policy statement: retained the overnight call rate target at around 0.5%. It characterized the economy as recovering moderately and recent ex-fresh-food CPI inflation as around 3.0-3.5%.

US Federal Reserve FOMC Mar 19 2025 statement: maintained policy rate target at 4.25%-4.50%; announced slower decline of Treasury holdings from April, reducing monthly Treasury redemption cap from $25 billion to $5 billion.
events.observed_result: Held 4.25%-4.50%; Treasury runoff cap to $5bn in April
